description.value: Level Yaletown – Seymour is a boutique extended-stay hotel in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood offering spacious furnished suites and townhome-style accommodations with fully-equipped kitchens and in-suite laundry. The property features over 11,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor amenities including an outdoor heated pool, hot tub, and a 2,000 sq ft fitness centre with sauna. It sits steps from Yaletown's dining, shopping, and nightlife, and within minutes of beaches and outdoor recreation.
